title: Care grows richer through understanding

captions.emotions: Enjoy the fruits of shared attention

meaning: Your union can find richness in what you create together when experience makes care more precise and closer to everyday life.
text: What you create together may gradually acquire a history of its own. In the physical position, the Empress sets creative actions: growing, arranging and sustaining beginnings. In energy, the Hermit directs effort through understanding experience. You want to discover what actually helps and share what you find. In emotions, the Empress returns in another role: you enjoy fruitfulness, a sense of fullness and visible results of attention. The value of what you create can increase through understanding, alongside any growth in the number of things or tasks.

For example, you gradually learn to bake bread. After the first attempts, you note what worked and discuss mistakes. Eventually, you find a simple recipe that suits an ordinary morning. Pleasure comes from both the loaf and an understandable route towards it. **Shared care becomes more precise when experience is available to you both.** Something good can be repeated without starting entirely afresh or depending on one person to guard a household secret. The knowledge belongs within your connection.

The difficulty appears if understanding becomes the right to decide alone what is correct. You know the successful method so well that another attempt seems wasteful. Creation continues in a narrower space: repeat what has been proved and protect the result. Trying to preserve fruitfulness, you gradually lose mutual interest. Experience stays alive when it also allows another shared mistake.
